text:
sanjay: Quick heads-up — rolling out the 'odd-even lane' canary for routing-v2 at 10:30 PT. Plan: 5% (10m) -> 15% (10m) -> 40% (10m). Cohorts: odd user IDs => geo=us-west, even user IDs => geo=us-east. Primary owner: @maria. Who's owning smoke and rollback readiness?

maria: Got it. I'll own smoke. I'll be online at 10:15 PT. Smoke checklist: p95 < 120ms, error rate < 0.5%, no tail-latency spike. I'll post results in this thread.

jen: I'll run the e2e prompt harness. Command I'll run: `./tools/smoke/run_canary.sh --cohort odd --iter 1000`. Will validate KV-cache warmup and model responses.

deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout created: release/routing-v2-2026-03-18. Canary slices: odd/even lanes. Auto-fallback configured to routing-v1.

rae: Do we have a quality observation window defined? Need to validate rerank drift and top-k changes per stage.

maria: Yes — QA will run rerank A/B on 2k samples during each step. @helga will track quality regressions and post diffs.

helga: I'll watch quality. Quick rule: if top1 change rate > 2% we halt and call rollback. I'll post the diff summary after each stage.

oscar: I'll be on infra standby. If model-serving errors or pool OOMs exceed thresholds I'll flip the feature flag and notify. Ping me between 10:20-11:00 PT.

sanjay: Can someone confirm the rollout percentages in the deploy config? Snippet below: ```json
{"stages": [{"percent": 5, "duration_min":10}, {"percent":15, "duration_min":10}, {"percent":40, "duration_min":10}]}```

jen: Config looks correct. Question: are we enabling prefix-caching for odd lane only? That was toggled in the last PR.

sanjay: Yes — prefix cache ON for odd, OFF for even so we can measure benefit. KV prewarm is enabled for both lanes.

maria: Rollback plan: immediate set percent=0 + traffic switch to routing-v1 via CLI: `rw rollout set --release routing-v2 --percent 0 && rw routing switch --to routing-v1`. If needed we'll also disable prefix cache.

helga: Smoke verification commands I'll run: `jq '.latency.p95' smoke_results.json` and `python tools/compare_ranks.py baseline.json current.json` — will paste outputs.

maria: If smoke passes at 5% we proceed to 15% after a short observation (target ~12m). If any critical error, we stop and run rollback. I'll add a canary tag in the console and monitor metrics.

sanjay: Thanks all. I'll kick the release at 10:30 PT. @oscar pls stand by 10:25-11:00 PT.

oscar: On standby :thumbsup: 

deploy-bot: deploy started by sanjay at 1738802468

sanjay: Update — 5% stage finished. @maria how's smoke?

maria: Smoke OK. p95 98ms, errors 0.12%. QA diffs small, no regression flagged. Proceeding to 15%.

helga: Quality check: top1 change 0.8%, below threshold. No halt.

jen: Kicking off 15% stage now, running e2e and rerank checks.

maria: All green at 15%. Moving to 40%.

oscar: Infra stable, no pool errors or throttling.

sanjay: Final stage (40%) completed. Will schedule GA rollout tomorrow morning unless objections. Thanks team :tada:

maria: Sweet — I saved smoke logs and QA diffs to the release folder.

helga: Archived diffs at s3://redwood-ci/release-routing-v2/quality-diffs/1738802468/

sanjay: Closing thread — great run. Will follow up with post-rollout metrics and cost delta.
